_about: ORDER shelf-w6d3 step 3 registry for lanes/wire/wire.mjs. A wire = a stdio/HTTP MCP connection Timmy uses; a bridge = an MCP server that fronts another tool. NO secret values here: only env var NAMES (envNames) and where the runtime reads them from (envFrom). Paths use $ROOT for the worktree root and ~ for $HOME.

mcpsnoop.role: transparent stdio/HTTP proxy that records every JSON-RPC frame; export json/har; check signals

mcp-probe.role: protocol-compliance validate + automated test suite; stdio (single --args value per occurrence, repeatable) or --http-stream/--http-sse

apisnip.role: trim an OpenAPI surface (interactive ratatui TUI; only -h/-V flags)

mcpc.role: universal MCP CLI client with named background sessions; stdio servers must come from a config file entry (file:entry)

cmcp.needs: Go 1.21+ toolchain + Claude CLI; wraps `claude mcp add/add-json/remove/list/get`
cmcp.role: Claude-CLI MCP registration manager (does not speak MCP)
